semiconductor_relevance: High — Ferrotec Taiwan Co., Ltd. specializes in quartz and silicon products, which are critical materials in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Ferrotec Taiwan Co., Ltd. provides essential materials and components for the semiconductor industry, including quartz and silicon products, as well as vacuum magnetic fluid bearings used in semiconductor and LCD panel equipment. The company aims to support the high-tech industry in Taiwan with comprehensive after-sales services.
capabilities: Quartz and silicon products for semiconductor applications
Vacuum magnetic fluid bearings for semiconductor equipment

regional_presence.Taiwan: Ferrotec has established a sales branch in Hsinchu to better serve Taiwanese customers in the high-tech industry.
